Sara told Shirley she knew it was hard and saw how much Shirley cared. Shirley said it had been tough and she kept thinking if more could have been done. Shirley said she wasn’t sure she could and didn’t want to seem unprofessional or weak. Sara said emotions don’t make her weak and are healthy among friends. Shirley said maybe Sara was right and she’d try to be more open.
- **Apology:** Sara felt she may have been too harsh and apologized for coming on too strong. Shirley said it was a bit much but Sara meant well and she appreciated the apology. Sara said she was there for Shirley however needed. Shirley thanked her and said they should keep talking because it helps.
- **Later support:** Sara noticed Shirley seemed improved. Sara asked how she felt. Shirley said she felt better thanks to their talks and Sara’s support. Sara suggested spending time together outside work. Shirley agreed to plan something for the weekend.
